title: Q3 Roadmap Mosaic Readout — scenario asks & decision ledger
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Prepare a compact, decision-focused readout for the Q3 roadmap checkpoint that presents three scenario lanes and concrete executive asks. This ticket coordinates cross-functional inputs, final slide deck, and the decision ledger we'll present at the exec QBR.

Background: We run a mosaic-style readout so executives can quickly choose resource lanes (Base | Accelerate | Conservative). This is driven by latest inference economics analysis (runtime kernel improvements + Dedicated capacity uptake) and asks from Platform, Runtime, and SalesOps.

Goals: 
- Surface 3 clear investment scenarios with quantitative cost / revenue impact and key risks.
- Obtain binary decisions on two runway asks (runtime perf investment and Dedicated pricing pilot).
- Align on OKR checkpoints and rollback lanes if signal thresholds miss.

Audience: CEO, CTO, Head of Product, Head of Engineering, Head of GTM.

Key asks (for slide Q/A):
1) Approve $1.2M incremental investment in runtime-1.21 performance program (target: 20% token cost reduction for long-tail seqs). Decision deadline: QBR signoff.
2) Greenlight a 6-month Dedicated pricing pilot with two anchor customers and committed SLOs. Budget scoped under commercial pilot funding.
3) Endorse the proposed rollback policy (canary -> 25% -> global) for model rollouts tied to quality monitors.

Attachments and artifacts: final deck (Drive), model econ workbook (Sheets), perf dashboard (Grafana), PR for runtime baseline changes (GitHub). Links below.

Risks & mitigations: 
- If perf rollout misses latency SLOs we shift to conservative lane and allocate hot-path kernel work to a fast-track squad (ENG contingency).
- Dedicated pilot could depress short-term margins; mitigation: fixed pilot pricing and success metrics tied to net new ARR.

Deliverables: final 10-slide deck, one-pager decision ledger, updated OKR mapping, annotated scenario financial model, and an action tracker with owners and dates.

Next steps: finalize deck with Design notes by 2026-03-12, review with Finance on 2026-03-11, exec dry-run on 2026-03-16, publish readout materials and decision ledger on 2026-03-17.
